title: Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes — Issue Grounds, Trips Granted and Validity by Product
content:
Each product in Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes is issued only on the grounds listed for it below, carries the number of companion trips shown, and stays bookable for the number of calendar months shown, counted from its issue date to its book-by date.

## Grounds of issue

| Product | Grounds on which it is issued | Summit membership required | Further entry condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin | co-brand card anniversary | yes | card purchases in the card membership year of at least the spend requirement below |
| Crestline Companion Certificate Main Plus | co-brand card anniversary; Summit choice benefit for Summit Platinum | yes | card purchases as below, for the card-anniversary ground |
| Crestline Companion Certificate Premium Economy | co-brand card anniversary; Summit choice benefit for Summit Diamond | yes | card purchases as below, for the card-anniversary ground |
| Crestline Companion Certificate First | co-brand card anniversary; Summit choice benefit for Summit Chairman | yes | card purchases as below, for the card-anniversary ground |
| Crestline Companion Pass Semiannual | promotion | yes | 30 qualifying flown segments in the prior six months |
| Crestline Companion Pass Annual | promotion | yes | 90 qualifying flown segments in the prior twelve months |

## Issue schedule

| Product | Companion trips granted | Validity (calendar months, issue date to book-by date) | Issue period after the card anniversary or promotion qualification (calendar days) | Card purchases required in the card membership year (USD; 0 means none) | Most held of this product in issued or active status at once | Unused product revoked when the holder's Summit membership closes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Certificate Main Cabin | 1 | 12 | 56 | 0 | 3 | yes |
| Certificate Main Plus | 1 | 12 | 56 | 0 | 3 | yes |
| Certificate Premium Economy | 1 | 12 | 56 | 20000 | 2 | yes |
| Certificate First | 1 | 12 | 56 | 30000 | 2 | yes |
| Pass Semiannual | 8 | 6 | 14 | 0 | 1 | yes |
| Pass Annual | 16 | 12 | 14 | 0 | 1 | yes |

## Reading the schedule

- The four certificates each carry a single companion trip and are valid for 12 months. The Pass Semiannual carries 8 trips over 6 months and the Pass Annual 16 trips over 12 months.
- A card-anniversary Premium Economy certificate needs card purchases of 20000 USD in the card membership year, and a card-anniversary First certificate needs 30000 USD; the Main Cabin and Main Plus certificates have no purchase requirement (0).
- Certificates are issued within 56 calendar days after the card anniversary; passes within 14 calendar days after the holder's promotion qualification.
- Every product requires the holder to have a Summit membership, and every product's unused balance is revoked when that membership closes.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A holder with two Crestline Companion Certificate Premium Economy certificates, both active, already holds the most this product allows (2); a third would exceed the limit. A holder with one active Crestline Companion Pass Annual already holds the most of that pass (1).
